diagram.title: Concept map: from conditioning to Bayes
diagram.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A["Sample space"] --> B["Probability axioms"]
  B --> C["Conditional probability"]
  C -->|"multiplication rule"| D["Law of total probability"]
  C --> E["Independence"]
  D --> F["Bayes' theorem"]
  C --> F
diagram.explanation: The arrows show prerequisites: to understand Bayes' theorem you need conditional probability and the law of total probability. Independence is defined through conditioning.
